tagline: Discovering and developing innovative medicines that solve serious health issues
hero_kpi_rationale: The 'Rinvoq Exclusivity' KPI is the hero because it captures major revenue protection through 2037, a rare structural advantage in biopharma, ensuring stability and visibility against generic competition.

kpis.name: Rinvoq Exclusivity (US)
kpis.explanation: Date on which no generic version of Rinvoq can enter the U.S. market.
kpis.description: In September 2025, AbbVie reached an agreement with all generic manufacturers, delaying the entry of generic versions of Rinvoq in the United States until April 2037, subject to pediatric exclusivity.
kpis.signal: Patent protection extended to 2037 through a licensing agreement.

kpis.name: Global Net Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total product sales after deductions and discounts.
kpis.description: Global net revenue was $61.2 billion in 2025, an increase of 9% year-over-year, in both reported and constant currency terms.
kpis.signal: Strong organic growth driven by key products such as Skyrizi and Rinvoq.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin was 24.7% in 2025, calculated from an operating profit of $15.1 billion on $61.2 billion in revenue.
kpis.signal: High margin despite significant amortization, reflecting commercial strength.

kpis.name: Research and Development Expenses
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in the discovery and development of new drugs and compounds.
kpis.description: The exact amount of R&D expenses is not specifically detailed in the 10-K. However, implicit expenses include amortization of intangible assets ($7.4 B), change in fair value of contingent consideration ($6.5 B), and acquisition-related expenses ($276 M), indicating a strong commitment to R&D to maintain a pipeline of 90 programs, including 60 in mid- or late-stage development.
kpis.signal: Significant investment in a robust pipeline of 90 development programs.

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated from the company's core business activities.
kpis.description: Operating cash flow reached $19.0 billion in 2025, supporting R&D investments, acquisitions, and dividends.
kpis.signal: High cash flow enabling reinvestment and shareholder returns.

kpis.name: Development Programs
kpis.explanation: Total number of drugs, devices, or indications in development.
kpis.description: AbbVie's pipeline includes approximately 90 programs, with about 60 in mid- or late-stage development, spanning immunology, neurological disorders, oncology, aesthetics, and obesity.
kpis.signal: Rich and diversified pipeline, with 60 programs in mid- or late-stage development.

kpis.name: U.S. Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Capital commitment for new manufacturing and R&D facilities in the United States.
kpis.description: In January 2026, AbbVie announced a voluntary agreement with the U.S. government committing to invest $100 billion in the United States over the next decade in research and development and manufacturing. In return, the U.S. government will grant a three-year exemption from tariffs and future price mandates.
kpis.signal: Strategic $100 billion, 10-year pact to strengthen domestic U.S. production.

kpis.name: Products Under Government Pricing
kpis.explanation: Number of AbbVie products subject to pricing set by the U.S. government.
kpis.description: Four major AbbVie products have been selected for government-set pricing under the Inflation Reduction Act: Imbruvica (2026), Vraylar and Linzess (2027), Botox (2028).
kpis.signal: Increasing pressure on Medicare pricing affecting Imbruvica, Vraylar, Linzess, and Botox.

risks.title: Loss of Exclusivity
risks.score_rationale: The loss of exclusivity for Humira had a significant impact, but Rinvoq benefits from protection through 2037

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: Growing competition in the biologic drug market could affect AbbVie's sales

risks.title: Dependence on Key Products
risks.score_rationale: AbbVie's revenue is highly dependent on a few key products such as Skyrizi and Rinvoq

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: Changes in regulations or healthcare laws could affect AbbVie's operations, including Medicare price setting

risks.title: New Product Development
risks.score_rationale: AbbVie's success depends on its ability to develop new products to replace older ones

risks.title: Supply Chain Risks
risks.score_rationale: Disruptions in the supply chain could affect product manufacturing and delivery

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risks
risks.score_rationale: Cyberattacks could compromise data confidentiality and disrupt operations
